title: Weightless Reach
description: Weightless Reach overhauls minecraft quite much by adding new content without overdoing anything.
body:
****Weightless Reach** adds a plethora of new blocks, biomes and mobs. It focuses on making the boring parts of core minecraft gameplay like gathering resources or exploring a bit easier, less annoying and more satisfying. In this modpack you'll find the overworld really beatifull and peacefull but more dangerous parts of the minecraft world like the nether more intimidating than usual**![peacefull overworld, dangerous nether](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90d34ec59599f40dace69af07063cf977879d5a3.jpeg)
biggest changes: new overworld and nether world generation, tree physics, new mobs, new blocks, new textures
